$comment: Implements spec 03 §2.1 (locales/en.json, sw.json: labels, descriptors and comment-bank seeds) and §8.2 (multilingual template labels from the pack locale). One locale file per language; the pack maps language tags to this shape.
title: Curriculum pack locale
description: Translated labels, band descriptors and comment-bank seeds for one language (spec 03 §2.1, §8.2).

labels.description: Template and field labels keyed by locale key, for example report.results or block.attendance. Report templates reference these keys through block label_key (spec 03 §8.2).

descriptors.description: Descriptor text by scale code and then band code, for example cbe_8_level.EE1 (spec 03 §2.1 comment-bank and descriptor seeds; §5 band descriptor).

comment_bank.description: Seed remarks a teacher can insert, filtered by scope and band (spec 03 §8.2 comment-bank suggestions by band; spec 02 §8 comment_bank_entry).

band.description: Band or level code the remark suits, for example EE1 or B+.

text.description: The remark text in this locale (spec 03 §8.2).

learning_area.description: Optional learning-area code when the remark only fits one subject.
